metadata.pitch: A floating night market loses gravity. Pip is hit by a runaway lantern and goes offline while sealed recipes still arrive. Boba can relay live orders but fails during the fireworks. Use three sparks wisely. Finish with a quiet sunrise.

level.brief: Night market floats loose. Pip goes dark, Boba drops during fireworks. You have 3 sparks: each boosts Pip +2 for one turn. Spend wisely.
level.title: Floating Night Market: Zero-G Lantern Drift

turns.event: Stalls light up, dumpling steam curls over the docks.
Gravity hiccups, soup bowls wobble and lift off.
Runaway lantern smacks Pip! Pip offline with a fizzle.
Sealed recipes pile up while Pip blinks dead.
Packet: lost spice manifest drifts by, grab or wait?
Pip reboots weakly, one eye flickering back on.
Choice: fireworks start! Boba fails, spend spark on Pip?
Fireworks boom, live orders crackle with no relay.
Smoke clears, Boba shakes sparks off whiskers.
Stalls tether down, last floating lanterns caught.
Choice: save last spark or light the dawn grill?
Quiet sunrise, warm buns shared in soft light.
